title: Immunization of Chickens with KLH-gp120 Conjugate to Raise Anti-KLH Antibodies
author: Angel A Justiz-Vaillant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bjvtkn6n
materials: The chickens are immunized on day 0, with 0.2 µmol/ml of the fragment 254-274 of HIV gp120-conjugated to KLH (immunogen) in 0.5 ml complete Freund’s adjuvant (Sigma-Aldrich Co, St. Louis Missouri).
On days 15, 60, and 90 chickens are immunized with 0.2 µmol/ml of the immunogen in 0.5 ml incomplete Freund’s adjuvant (Sigma-Aldrich Co, St. Louis Missouri).

steps.title: Immunize chickens with KLH conjugate
steps.instruction: Inject two healthy brown Leghorn layer chickens (≈6 months old) intramuscularly at multiple sites on the breast with the peptide‑KLH conjugate.

steps.title: Collect eggs and purify IgY
steps.instruction: Collect eggs after immunization and isolate immunoglobulin Y from the yolk using the Polson method (1990).

steps.title: Coat ELISA plate with KLH
steps.instruction: Add 1 µg µl⁻¹ of a KLH mixture in carbonate‑bicarbonate buffer (pH 9.6) to each well of a 96‑well microtitre plate and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Block plate with BSA
steps.instruction: Treat the coated plate with a bovine serum albumin (BSA) solution, then wash the wells four times with PBS‑Tween.

steps.title: Add egg‑derived IgY samples
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of the water‑soluble fraction from the purified eggs to each well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, and re‑wash the plate four times with PBS‑Tween.

steps.title: Add rabbit anti‑chicken IgY‑HRP
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of rabbit anti‑chicken IgY‑peroxidase conjugate diluted 1:30,000 in PBS containing non‑fat milk to each well, incubate 1 h at room temperature, then wash four times with PBS‑Tween.

steps.title: Add OPD substrate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of 4 mg ml⁻¹ o‑phenylenediamine (OPD) solution to each well and incubate 15 min at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Stop reaction with sulfuric acid
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of 3 M H₂SO₄ solution to each well to stop the enzymatic reaction.

steps.title: Read plate and calculate cutoff
steps.instruction: Visually assess colour development, then read absorbance at 492 nm using a microplate reader. Calculate the cut‑off as the mean optical density of negative controls multiplied by two standard deviations; higher OD values indicate greater anti‑KLH antibody levels.
